merges.why: Each treatment or service of a clinic is a block of one long Treatments page with an overview board at the top.
Every kind of booking belongs to one Book page, so the free consultation is a section there.
They are all ways to find the right care by concern or audience, so they sit as sections of one guide.
Brands, technology and hygiene standards support the clinic's story and trust, so they live in About us.
Rules, policies and questions form one page.
Memberships and loyalty are ongoing offers, so they sit with promotions.
All online ordering sits in one page, with vouchers as a section next to products.
Group experiences share one audience and one enquiry route, so they become sections of one Events page. Their booking forms live in Book online.

styleNotes: Soft, clean palette of warm neutrals, sage or blush with one deeper accent for buttons
Generous white space and light, elegant serif headings paired with a simple sans-serif body
Real, natural-light photography of skin, treatment rooms and team, avoiding heavy retouching
Reassuring clinical details (qualifications, hygiene) shown calmly, with clear and prominent booking buttons on mobile
